sql:
WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value,
    (
      COALESCE(o.comments, '') ILIKE '%promo%'
      OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ILIKE '%promo%'
      OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ILIKE '%promo%'
      OR COALESCE(BOOL_OR(ol.description ILIKE '%promo%'), FALSE)
      OR COALESCE(o.comments, '') ILIKE '%discount%'
      OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ILIKE '%discount%'
      OR COALESCE(BOOL_OR(ol.description ILIKE '%discount%'), FALSE)
      OR COALESCE(o.comments, '') ILIKE '%black friday%'
      OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ILIKE '%black friday%'
      OR COALESCE(BOOL_OR(ol.description ILIKE '%black friday%'), FALSE)
    ) AS has_promotion
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '2024-11-29'
    AND o.orderdate < DATE '2024-11-30'
  GROUP BY o.orderid, o.comments, o.internalcomments, o.deliveryinstructions
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN has_promotion THEN 'With promotion' ELSE 'Without promotion' END AS promotion_status,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  AVG(order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM order_values
GROUP BY has_promotion
ORDER BY has_promotion DESC
LIMIT 500

  SELECT sit.stockitemid

  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol
  WHERE ol.stockitemid = s.stockitemid
    AND COALESCE(ol.taxrate, 0) > 0

JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd ON sd.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
  AND (sd.customerid IS NULL OR sd.customerid = o.customerid)
ORDER BY o.orderid, ol.orderlineid, sd.specialdealid
LIMIT 500
